source:
@@U00701@@
You were late in leaving Rippach, I take it. Did you have dinner first with Signor Bumpkin?

@@U00703@@
No, we passed through without stopping. But we did speak last time. He asked if we'd give his best to his many Bumpkin cousins here in 莱比锡.

@@U00704@@
(He bows to 弗罗施.)

@@U00706@@
(In an undertone.)

@@U00707@@
See there? He’s on to us!

@@U00709@@
The crafty devil!

@@U00711@@
Just you wait. I'll get him yet.

@@U00713@@
Am I wrong, gentlemen, or did we hear in passing a well-trained chorus in song? A vaulted ceiling like this must make a wonderful echo.

@@U00715@@
Are you a virtuoso perhaps?

@@U00717@@
Oh, no, my talent’s not much, though my liking is great.

@@U00719@@
Give us a song!

@@U00721@@
As many as you like.
translation:
@@U00701@@
我想你离开里帕奇的时候已经晚了。你先和邦普金先生一起吃晚饭了吗？

@@U00703@@
不，我们没有停留就过去了。但我们上次确实谈过了。他问我们是否愿意为他在莱比锡的众多乡巴佬表兄弟尽力。

@@U00704@@
（他向弗罗施鞠躬。）

@@U00706@@
（低声说道。）

@@U00707@@
看到那里了吗？他正在对付我们！

@@U00709@@
狡猾的魔鬼！

@@U00711@@
就你等着吧。我还是会去找他的。

@@U00713@@
先生们，我错了吗？还是我们听到了训练有素的合唱？像这样的拱形天花板一定会产生美妙的回声。

@@U00715@@
也许你是一位艺术大师？

@@U00717@@
哦，不，我的天赋不多，虽然我的爱好很大。

@@U00719@@
给我们一首歌吧！

@@U00721@@
你喜欢多少就多少。
